services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: The Kubotan System of Self-defense utilizes a stick made of high density black plastic. It measures 5/8″ in diameter and 5-1/2″ in length and weighs 1/2 ounce. When keys are attached to a key ring at the end of the stick, the Kubotan becomes a very potent self-defense weapon. The techniques in the Kubotan System of Self-defense are direct, effective, and easy to learn. The techniques can be mastered in a very short period of time (1 to 1-1/2 hour sessions can provide participants with very effective self-defense skills), and they are easy to remember. The Kubotan System of Self-defense does not require any special athletic ability, exceptional strength, nor any knowledge of the martial
